description: Inspect a captured library asset (a vault recipe/component note, or a live TD COMP) and emit a suggested tag set, difficulty, and one-line description from a deterministic operator-family heuristic; with write:true, merge the suggestion into the note's frontmatter (preserving '*'-pinned user tags). Use this to backfill consistent tags across a library so browse_vault_library can find by category. Requires a configured TDMCP_VAULT_PATH; target='td_comp' additionally requires the bridge.

category_hint.description: Helps frontmatter shape; 'auto' infers from the note location (Recipes/* vs Components/*).

include_description.description: Generate a one-line description; only fills frontmatter.description when it is currently empty (never overwritten).

include_difficulty.description: Emit a 'beginner'|'intermediate'|'advanced' estimate from node count + complexity.

max_tags.description: Hard cap on suggested tag count after ranking.

min_confidence.description: Drop suggestions whose score falls below this threshold.

note_path.description: Vault-relative path of the note to tag (e.g. 'Recipes/audio_pulse.md'). Required when target='vault_note'; optional for 'td_comp'.

overwrite_existing_tags.description: When false, union with existing frontmatter.tags. When true, replace them (user-pinned tags prefixed '*' are always kept).

target.description: What to scan. 'vault_note' reads an existing note via the vault adapter; 'td_comp' captures a live COMP through the bridge.

write.description: When false, returns the suggestion as a dry-run. When true, merges the suggestion into the note's frontmatter and rewrites it.

name: auto_tag_library_asset
title: Auto-tag a vault library asset
